user.title: Crow Food
user.description: Set up Crow Food. There's nothing to fill in — add the Crow Food card to a dashboard, then open the card editor to choose who gets reminders and set up AI.

add.name: Add food
add.description: Add something to a storage. A product Crow Food doesn't know yet is created from its name.

name.name: Name
name.description: The product's name (or part of it).

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: The product's barcode, instead of or as well as its name.

storage.name: Storage
storage.description: Which storage (its name). Leave empty for the first one.

consume.name: Use up food
consume.description: Use some of a product (opened packets and the soonest expiry first), or throw it away.

name.name: Name
name.description: The product's name (or part of it).

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How much. Leave empty for all of it.

thrown_away.name: Thrown away
thrown_away.description: Count it as thrown away instead of eaten.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Add a product to a shopping list.

list.name: List
list.description: Which shopping list (its name). Leave empty for the first one.

send_reminder.name: Send reminder now
send_reminder.description: Sends today's note about expiring, expired and low food to the people chosen in the card editor.

backup.name: Back up now
backup.description: Saves a copy of everything in /config/crow_food/backups.
